description: Decide and implement the contract for a coverage target that cannot be instrumented. Resolved 2026-09-27: warn and continue rather than escalate a process-fatal error, recording the omission in the run diagnostics, the terminal report, and the artifact index. --min evaluates against the instrumented set, with a separate gate so an omission cannot be silently ignored. Applies to both the native and legacy runtimes, and stops the native collector from aborting all instrumentation on the first failure.
